description: Experimental Porous--Fisher conditioning study. It tests whether diagnostics flag hard states when a logistic reaction remains outside the diffusion preconditioner.

geometry_resolution.description: Final geometry readings were re-audited against the current conditioning revision at each record's already-recorded terminal budget with two restarts. Persisted source states were loaded and SHA256-verified; no source state or budget ladder was regenerated.
